parameters.help_en: The ID of the content moderation job. You can obtain the job ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91779.html operation. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. The token for the next page is returned in the response to the first request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，第一次提交时为空即可。下一页标识将在第一次查询后返回
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to return on each page.

Default: 30.

Valid values: 1 to 300
parameters.help_zh:
每页最大返回数。

默认：30
取值：1~300
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

parameters.help_en:
The state of the jobs to query. Valid values:

All: all jobs.

Queuing: jobs that are in the queue.

Analysing: jobs that are being analyzed.

Fail: failed jobs.

Success: successful jobs
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的作业状态。取值：

All：全部。

Queuing：排队中。

Analysing：分析中。

Fail：失败。

Success：成功
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query jobs by their creation time.

The date and time are in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC.

The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
最早任务创建时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_of_job_created_time_range

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query jobs by their creation time.

The date and time are in the ISO 8601 format and in UTC.

The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
最晚任务创建时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_of_job_created_time_range

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MPS queue. To obtain the MPS queue ID, log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) and choose Global Settings > MPS Queues and Callbacks

Label.description_en:
The labels of the moderation result. Multiple labels are separated by commas (,).

Labels for pornography detection (porn) results:

normal: normal

sexy: sexy

porn: pornographic

Labels for terrorism and political content detection (terrorism) results:

normal: normal

bloody: bloody

explosion: explosion

outfit: special outfit

logo: special logo

weapon: weapon

politics: political content

violence: violence

crowd: crowd

parade: parade

carcrash: car crash

flag: flag

location: landmark

others: others

Labels for ad and text violation detection (ad) results:

normal: normal

ad: other ads

politics: text containing political content

porn: text containing pornographic content

abuse: text containing abusive content

terrorism: text containing terrorist content

contraband: text containing contraband content

spam: other spam

npx: skin-disease-like ads

qrcode: QR code

programCode: miniapp code

Labels for undesirable scene detection (live) results:

normal: normal

meaningless: no content in the image (for example, a black or white screen)

PIP: Picture-in-Picture (PiP)

smoking: smoking

drivelive: live streaming in a car

Labels for logo detection (Logo) results:

normal: normal

TV: contains a controlled logo

trademark: contains a trademark
Label.description_zh:
审核结果的标签，多个使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

图片智能鉴黄（porn）审核结果分类：
    - nomal：正常。
    - sexy：性感。
    - porn：色情。

图片暴恐涉政（terrorism）结果分类：
    - naomal：正常。
    - bloody：血腥。
    - explosion：爆炸烟光。
    - outfit：特殊装束。
    - logo：特殊标识。
    - weapon：武器。
    - politics：涉政。
    - violence：打斗。
    - crowd：聚众。
    - parade：游行。
    - carcrash：车祸现场。
    - flag：旗帜。
    - location：地标。
    - others：其他。

图文违规（ad）结果分类：
    - normal：正常。
    - ad：其他广告。
    - politics：文字含涉政内容。
    - porn：文字含涉黄内容。
    - abuse：文字含辱骂内容。
    - terrorism：文字含暴恐内容。
    - contraband：文字含违禁内容。
    - spam：文字含其他垃圾内容。
    - npx：牛皮藓广告。
    - qrcode：含二维码。
    - programCode：含小程序码。

图片不良场景（live）结果分类：
    - normal：正常。
    - meaningless：图片中无内容（例如黑屏、白屏）。
    - PIP：画中画。
    - smoking：吸烟。
    - drivelive：车内直播。

图片Logo（Logo）结果分类：
    - normal：正常。
    - TV：含受管控的Logo。
    - trademark：含商标

Suggestion.description_en:
The overall moderation result of the job. Valid values:

pass: The content can be passed.

review: The content needs to be manually reviewed.

block: The content must be blocked.

If the moderation result for any category is review, the overall result is review. If the moderation result for any category is block, the overall result is block
Suggestion.description_zh:
作业整体审核结果。取值：

pass：通过。
review：人工重审。
block：拦截。

任何一种类型的审核结果是Review时，整体结果为Review，任何一种类型的审核结果是Block时，整体结果为Block
